reviewedChanges.evidence: DarwinActivity validates the 136/96/232 natural layout, required identity and coherent user-task counters; it requires an exact full-sized result and a successful nonzero timebase ratio. Task RSS is measured in bytes and CPU Mach counters are converted by that ratio.

Short/zero/errno-zero responses and permission failure remain unavailable. A measured RSS zero requires an otherwise coherent live task. Gone requires explicit zombie, ESRCH from positive-PID signal-zero, or replacement of the expected generation; none is inferred merely from a missing RSS field.

The native registry uses the shared strict BSD probe and expected-generation RSS query. Missing BSD info cannot silently remove a live identity; failed executable-path lookup also needs confirmed absence. Existing same-generation/argv ownership checks before cleanup signals remain.

Darwin ps supplies only PGID/PID inventory; RSS/CPU/runnable summary come from task-level measurements. Unknown aggregates stay null with explicit lower bounds and bounded retries. Recovered incomplete observations reset the stall clock. Derived R/S/T values are labeled libproc-runnable-summary.

Platform, free-disk, stage-log and private-native-size gates execute before process measurement. A known RSS lower-bound excess fails even when the total is unavailable. Complete group plus out-of-group owned RSS still enforces the memory limit.

PID/generation diagnostics use keyed run-local opaque tags, bounded examples and aggregate counters. The new probe does not publish process names, argv, raw PID/birth tuples, credentials or launch tokens.

Before Runtime source checkout, the workflow requires actual self measurement with positive RSS and a successful timebase/layout probe, then an owned churn stage with a completed libproc task-level sample. Portable mocks do not substitute for this future macOS gate.

resolvedDesignFindings.priorIssue: All-row ps thread-state completeness could stop progressing builds.
resolvedDesignFindings.resolution: Darwin no longer depends on per-thread ps state or its zeroed unmeasured task fields. Unavailable task-level measurements still fail after bounded retries.

resolvedDesignFindings.priorIssue: Native RSS and liveness helpers could map unavailable measurements to zero or absence.
resolvedDesignFindings.resolution: Shared strict probes now preserve unknown status in info/path/RSS and fail closed.
A process tag and identity tag remain stable across samples within the probe instance without publishing raw identity values.

focusedCoverage: coherent measured zero versus missing task information
permission failure and full-size zero-filled records
short BSD records versus independently confirmed disappearance
partial aggregate lower bounds and opaque tags
resource limits before an unavailable measurement

recovery2.nativeFailure: Host-startup guard observed the LaunchServices launcher before adoption; real browser spontaneous exit remains UNKNOWN.

causalDistinction.recovery4Intent: Remove the monitor reachability blocker so the separately reviewed native startup fix and evidence collection can run. This code review does not establish a browser-exit or authentication root cause.

limitations: The shared native API has not executed on macOS in this review; early native ABI/timebase/self/churn checks remain mandatory.
The inspected public kernel source supports the selected ABI and API semantics; exact source-to-binary identity for runner build 24G830 is unverified.
Task-level reads can still be unavailable during lifecycle or permission races. This design preserves bounded failure rather than promising all churn will be measurable.
Any later native diagnostic additions and final immutable fixture/caller binding need their own focused review.
